title: Load next monthly drop
description: Ingest the next unloaded month of real invoices. Once all 25 drops are loaded, the least recently processed drop is re-processed instead.
expected: Succeeds; real data issues are quarantined or flagged.

title: Replay last drop (idempotency)
description: Re-process the most recently loaded drop. Loads are idempotent, so no new rows should be written.

title: Flaky CRM API
description: The CRM returns HTTP 503 twice for every page before recovering. The extractor retries with exponential backoff and jitter.
expected: Succeeds after retries; retry count is recorded.

title: CRM outage
description: The CRM is down for the whole run. Retries are exhausted and the run fails before anything is written.

title: Corrupted file drop
description: About 7.5% of the next drop's lines are damaged in transit (truncated lines, wrong date locale, text in numeric fields, invalid bytes).
expected: Bad rows are quarantined, the quality gate fails and nothing is published.
